proof.command: cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=... go test ./cmd/listener/ -count=1 -run '^TestHealthz' -v -timeout 15m, then go test -overlay <cmd/listener/main.go at 0b78e948, the commit before the reorder> ./cmd/listener/ -count=1 -run '^TestHealthzStillReportsALostDurableWhileTheRoleClaimViewIsIncomplete$'.

The handler now reads the view after the consumer info and durableUnbound (main.go:476-481), and writeDependencyHealth and the degraded answer share dependencyUnavailable, so both read alike.
proof.negativeControl: The overlay run at 0b78e948's main.go, where the view was read before the durable checks: '--- FAIL ... /healthz with the durable gone and the role claim view incomplete = 200 map[error:role claim view unavailable: ... status:degraded], want 503 unhealthy'. observations.what: This pod was recreated between rounds, and the round-1 and round-2 harness went with it.
observations.evidence: $TMPDIR/infra757 kept only its PostgreSQL data directory and pg-up.sh; the loop script, every compiled test binary and every overlay were gone. This round rebuilt them under $TMPDIR/t757c, so none of its readings rests on a binary an earlier round built.

observations.what: A failed pg_ctl start removes the running server's pid file and shuts it down, which cost this round one pair of loops.
observations.evidence: pg-up.sh's pg_ctl start, run while another role's postmaster already held port 5457, logged 'could not bind IPv4 address 127.0.0.1: Address already in use' and left no postmaster.pid; the running server then logged 'performing immediate shutdown because data directory lock file is invalid' at 04:57:04Z. The two flake A loops that followed failed every run in five seconds on 'connect: connection refused'. The database was started again and the loops re-run, and the figures above are the re-run's. A role that shares this pod's Postgres should check pg_isready before pg-up.sh rather than after it.

observations.what: A watcher fault of the role claim bucket is still reported under the interest cache's name.
observations.evidence: Unchanged from round 2 and from main: listenerCaches names the whole store.Registry 'interest', so a role claim watcher that ends answers /healthz '503 interest KV watcher unavailable: role claims watcher stopped'. The status and the cause are right and only the dependency's name is wrong; this change adds the degraded report after those checks and alters none of them.
